verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own marketplace claims 334,081 published Skills, more than 100,000 MCP servers ranked by activity, stability and community feedback, and over 311,000 community Agents. Its publish and version tooling (market-cli and lhm) and the community remix framing support an active ecosystem, and listing counts rise across snapshots (100,833 to 112,511 MCP servers). missing for 10: direct evidence of active maintainers (update frequency, maintainer responsiveness), independent or community corroboration that listings are genuinely alive rather than aggregated or stale.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers

citations.quote: Browse 334,081 Skills built agent-first and open to every stack. Publish SKILL.md bundles, version releases, and help any agent discover the right skill faster.
Explore 112,511 MCP Servers, ranked by activity, stability, and community feedback
Discover 311,770 ready-to-use Agents for writing, Q&A, images, video, voice, and workflows.
Through the LobeHub community, anyone can discover, reuse, and remix agent teammates and teams
Publish, version, and manage MCP plugin listings on the LobeHub Marketplace via the lhm CLI.
